import pytest

@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+"""Error hierarchy shared by the connector registry and implementations."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+KNOWN_CONNECTOR_KINDS: tuple[str, ...] = ("mcp",)
+
+
+class RegistryError(Exception):
+    """Base class for connector registry errors."""
+
+
+class UnknownConnectorKindError(RegistryError):
+    """Raised when a connector kind is not recognised."""
+
+    def __init__(self, name: str) -> None:
+        self.name = name
+        known = ", ".join(KNOWN_CONNECTOR_KINDS)
+        super().__init__(f"unknown connector kind {name!r}; known kinds: {known}")
+
+
+class DuplicateConnectorError(RegistryError):
+    """Raised when two connectors share the same name."""
+
+
+class ConnectorNotFoundError(RegistryError):
+    """Raised when a connector cannot be found in the registry."""
diff --git a/connectors/src/connectors/models.py b/connectors/src/connectors/models.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7df79fd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/connectors/src/connectors/models.py
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+"""Shared Pydantic models for connector configuration and ingest payloads."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any, Literal
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
+
+from .errors import UnknownConnectorKindError
+
+
+class HealthStatus(BaseModel):
+    ok: bool
+    detail: str = ""
+
+
+class McpConnectorSettings(BaseModel):
+    url: str
+    tools: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+
+
+class ConnectorConfig(BaseModel):
+    name: str
+    kind: str = "mcp"
+    enabled: bool = True
+    settings: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    def mcp_settings(self) -> McpConnectorSettings:
+        if self.kind != "mcp":
+            raise UnknownConnectorKindError(name=self.kind)
+        return McpConnectorSettings.model_validate(self.settings)
+
+
+class IngestRecord(BaseModel):
+    id: str
+    source_name: str
+    source_kind: str
+    item_type: Literal["resource", "tool_result", "catalog"]
+    name: str
+    content: str
+    raw: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
+
+
+class IngestBatch(BaseModel):
+    connector_name: str
+    records: list[IngestRecord] = Field(default_factory=list)
+    errors: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
diff --git a/connectors/src/connectors/protocol.py b/connectors/src/connectors/protocol.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8cfe088
--- /dev/null
+++ b/connectors/src/connectors/protocol.py
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+"""The structural interface every connector implements."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Protocol, runtime_checkable
+
+from .models import HealthStatus, IngestBatch
+
+
+@runtime_checkable
+class Connector(Protocol):
+    kind: str
+    name: str
+
+    async def health(self) -> HealthStatus: ...
+
+    async def ingest(self) -> IngestBatch: ...

+import pytest
+from connectors import ConnectorConfig, McpConnectorSettings
+from connectors.errors import UnknownConnectorKindError
+
+
+def test_mcp_settings_parse_url_and_tools():
+    s = McpConnectorSettings.model_validate({"url": "http://h/mcp", "tools": ["a"]})

+
